text: The authors report that process supervision, which provides feedback for each intermediate reasoning step, significantly outperforms outcome supervision, which provides feedback for a final result, for training models to solve problems from the challenging MATH dataset; their process-supervised model solves 78% of problems from a representative subset of the MATH test set. They also report that active learning significantly improves the efficacy of process supervision and release PRM800K, the complete dataset of 800,000 step-level human feedback labels used to train their best reward model.
title: Process supervision (step-level feedback) outperforms outcome supervision on MATH
